name: notify
description: Desktop notification when the agent finishes or waits on a permission prompt or other input, with the project folder as title and an optional sound. Uses notify-send on Linux and osascript on macOS; makes no network or model calls.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: off (no hook, no process) or on.

events.title: Events
events.description: Comma-separated: finish (the agent stopped) and input (it waits on a permission prompt or other input). Empty or unrecognized means both.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: off (default) or on: ask the notifier to play its sound. On Linux this depends on the notification server.
